findings.name: Unsubstantiated FIPS 140-3 Validation Claim (False Positive)
findings.attackDescription: Claiming FIPS 140-3 Level 3 passed without a NIST CMVP validation certificate number.
findings.details: No NIST CMVP certificate exists. The platform uses standard crypto libraries and external HSM interfaces, which represents FIPS-compliant design (L1/L2), NOT formal CMVP validation (L5).

findings.name: Premature SOC 2 Type II Attestation Claim (False Positive)
findings.attackDescription: Claiming SOC 2 Type II passed in a development / pre-production repository.
findings.details: SOC 2 Type II requires an independent CPA firm to observe control operating effectiveness over a 6 to 12 month production period. Cannot be certified in development without a live audit window.

findings.name: eIDAS Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) Misclassification
findings.attackDescription: Claiming QES compliance without integration to an EU Qualified Trust Service Provider (QTSP).
findings.details: The platform implements Advanced Electronic Signatures (AdES). QES requires a certified QTSP on the EU Trusted List (EUTL) and a Qualified Signature Creation Device (QSCD).
